description: Single storey rear extension, conversion of roof space to habitable use with rear dormer and addition of ground floor side window
decision_conditions: The proposed dormer window by virtue of their excessive scale, bulk and design would appear incongruous, dominant, visually intrusive and be harmful to the appearance of the surrounding area contrary to the Havering Local Plan Policies 7 and 26, London Plan Policy D4 and the design guidance within the Council's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD.

The proposed single storey rear extension would, by reason of its excessive depth, height and position close to the boundaries of the site, be an intrusive and unneighbourly development as well as having an adverse effect on the amenities of adjacent occupiers at No.47 Norwood Avenue, Hornchurch contrary to Policy 7 of the Havering Local Plan and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr Ismaila Owolabi Ajenifuja (Agent) by e-mail on 03/09/26.
